title: From JSON Outline to Downloadable Slides
subtitle: Synthetic technical demo: a local presentation workflow in WeKnora

slides.title: A Small, Inspectable Build Contract
bullets: Read the installed skill instructions through read_file before execution.
Keep the editable JSON outline in /workspace/deck.json.
Select presentation-builder with shell_exec to use its Python environment.

slides.title: Files Have Distinct Roles
rows: Read local images; never modify originals
Publish a new PPTX; never overwrite

slides.title: Validation Before Publication
bullets: Require explicit slide types and reject unknown JSON fields.
Bound slide count, text length, image pixels, and artifact size.
Reject traversal, symbolic links, and non-regular input files.
Publish only a completed deck using an unused output basename.

slides.title: A Reproducible Verification Pass
rows: Valid ZIP with presentation, slide, and relationship parts
One cover plus four content slides
Nonempty slide text and native table cells
Pinned dependencies in a network-disabled runtime
